notes.title: HOTFIX v0.34.20
notes.notes:
Thanks to your reports, we’ve tracked down a bug affecting story progression.

FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS:

- Fixed a bug in the coffee shop that was blocking players from continuing the story.

notes.title: Peach Hills Division v0.34 Patch #3
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Huge thanks to all of you who reported bugs and shared your feedback — it really helps us improve the game

Here’s what’s been fixed in this patch:

- Mission tracking now updates correctly.
- Fixed a bug that prevented players from getting a quest item from the store NPC.
- Other minor improvements and polish.

Your feedback is invaluable — keep it coming!
Cheers!

notes.title: Peach Hills Division 0.34.10 (Hotfix 2)

- Other Minor Bugs

notes.title: Raven's Deployment Update- v0.34.01
notes.notes: [p]The main feedback we've been getting since launch is, "ADD MORE CONTENT."[/p][p]Specifically, 3D animated content.[/p][p][/p][p]Rest assured- that's what we've been working on! We posted some teasers of what we've been working on a while back, but now we're here to finally get it into your hands- [b]new animated sex scenes,[/b] new story content, a new minigame, as well as neat bonuses such as the ability to unlock and collect [b]Steam Trading Cards[/b] by playing the game.[/p][p][/p][p]The following is a rough overview of what's in the patch, but you'll have to dive into the game to check out the new content for yourself!
